# gh-1292: fa-tokens line must reach stdout in headless/CI runs (ledger emission invisible to the GH log)

## Description

fa#1241/#1243 shipped the usage ledger + fa-tokens segment-close line — but the line is emitted via _logDiagnostic (agent_cli_diag_log.dart:15), which writes ONLY to ~/.fah/logs/fa.log (by design: 'TUI/stderr stay clean'). In GH Actions legs the runner's ~/.fah dies with the runner — the dmtools-agents token reporter (gh-735/#736) greps run logs and finds ZERO fa-tokens lines (verified: 50/50 newest fa runs noUsage today).

Test: headless session with a closed segment → stdout contains 'fa-tokens: {"sessionId":...'.

# gh-1292: fa-tokens line must reach stdout in headless/CI runs (ledger emission invisible to the GH log)

## Description

fa#1241/#1243 shipped the usage ledger + fa-tokens segment-close line — but the line is emitted via _logDiagnostic (agent_cli_diag_log.dart:15), which writes ONLY to ~/.fah/logs/fa.log (by design: 'TUI/stderr stay clean'). In GH Actions legs the runner's ~/.fah dies with the runner — the dmtools-agents token reporter (gh-735/#736) greps run logs and finds ZERO fa-tokens lines (verified: 50/50 newest fa runs noUsage today).

Fix: in headless mode (no TUI attached — the leg invocation), emit the fa-tokens line to stdout as well (the diag-file write can stay). Guard: TUI sessions keep stdout clean; headless/CI sessions get the line where the log capture sees it.

Test: headless session with a closed segment → stdout contains 'fa-tokens: {"sessionId":...'.

# gh-1292: fa-tokens line must reach stdout in headless/CI runs (ledger emission invisible to the GH log)

## Description

fa#1241/#1243 shipped the usage ledger + fa-tokens segment-close line — but the line is emitted via _logDiagnostic (agent_cli_diag_log.dart:15), which writes ONLY to ~/.fah/logs/fa.log (by design: 'TUI/stderr stay clean'). Test: headless session with a closed segment → stdout contains 'fa-tokens: {"sessionId":...'.

💡 **SUGGESTION: PR description is stale — it still describes the reverted round-1 design**

The PR description (and its flow diagram) says the `fa-tokens:` line is mirrored "to stdout (via `CliIO.write`)" behind a flag named `mirrorTokensLineToStdout`, and the "How to verify" section claims "headless run → stdout line matches `usageTokensLogPattern`". That is the round-1 design that went red (10 stdout-contract failures) and was reverted.

The shipped code is different and correct:

- Flag: `mirrorTokensLineToRunLog` (this line).
- Channel: `io.writeln` — the diagnostics channel, which headless hosts route to stderr (`bin/fah_io.dart:44`, AGENTS.md: "writeln = diagnostics (stderr headless)"); stdout stays pipeable prose (issue #774 AC3).
- The new tests assert the opposite of the description: `splitIo.out` must be exactly `'ok\n'` and the line must appear on the diag channel.

Since the discussion threads carry the authoritative round-2 explanation, this is docs polish, not a blocker — but please refresh the PR description (mechanism, flag name, flow diagram, and the "How to verify" bullet) so the PR's durable summary matches the merged behavior. Future readers (and machine summarizers) should not re-learn that `CliIO.write` was the broken variant.

💡 **SUGGESTION: redundant assertion — the pinned regex already covers this**

`usageTokensLogPattern` is anchored as `^fa-tokens: \{"sessionId":"[^"]*",...` (lib/src/usage/usage_log_line.dart:22), and the preceding line already asserts:

```dart
expect(usageTokensLogPattern.hasMatch(lines.single), isTrue);
```

so this line can never fail independently:

```dart
expect(lines.single, contains('"sessionId":'));
```

The full-shape regex match is the stronger pin (it is the external reporter's contract); the `contains` check adds noise without adding coverage. Dropping it keeps the test focused on what matters: exactly one line on the diag channel, matching the reporter's pinned pattern, with no timestamp prefix (which the `^` anchor already enforces).

# gh-1292: fa-tokens line must reach stdout in headless/CI runs (ledger emission invisible to the GH log)

## Description

fa#1241/#1243 shipped the usage ledger + fa-tokens segment-close line — but the line is emitted via _logDiagnostic (agent_cli_diag_log.dart:15), which writes ONLY to ~/.fah/logs/fa.log (by design: 'TUI/stderr stay clean'). Test: headless session with a closed segment → stdout contains 'fa-tokens: {"sessionId":...'.

# gh-1292: fa-tokens line must reach stdout in headless/CI runs (ledger emission invisible to the GH log)

## Description

fa#1241/#1243 shipped the usage ledger + fa-tokens segment-close line — but the line is emitted via _logDiagnostic (agent_cli_diag_log.dart:15), which writes ONLY to ~/.fah/logs/fa.log (by design: 'TUI/stderr stay clean'). Test: headless session with a closed segment → stdout contains 'fa-tokens: {"sessionId":...'.

Diff checklist — apply to `pr_diff.txt` For every hunk, ask at least these questions: - [ ] Does the change match the ticket scope? Any scope creep? - [ ] Are new or changed public APIs contract-safe for existing callers? - [ ] Is user/external input validated, sanitized, or escaped? - [ ] Are secrets, tokens, or PATs handled safely — not logged, not interpolated into shell scripts? - [ ] Are new or modified files present under `testing/` in a non-test-automation PR? - [ ] Is dead code, unused imports, or obvious duplication introduced? - [ ] Are error paths handled, or are failures silently swallowed? - [ ] Are new dependencies justified and compatible with the existing stack? - [ ] Beyond blockers: what other maintainability, correctness, or quality improvements are visible in the changed code? ## 3. Does not block merge. When in doubt, start one level higher; downgrade only after confirming the risk is negligible. ## 7. Exhaustive single-pass review Treat **every** review as the final and only review pass. The author will not get another chance to catch missed findings cheaply. - Do not defer SUGGESTION or IMPORTANT items to a later round because a BLOCKING issue exists. - After classifying all findings, re-read every changed file and ask: *"What else is improvable here?"* - Before writing outputs, verify that no obvious quality, maintainability, or correctness issue was left unreported. - Aim to surface the maximum number of actionable findings in this single iteration. ## 8. # gh-1292: fa-tokens line must reach stdout in headless/CI runs (ledger emission invisible to the GH log)

## Description

fa#1241/#1243 shipped the usage ledger + fa-tokens segment-close line — but the line is emitted via _logDiagnostic (agent_cli_diag_log.dart:15), which writes ONLY to ~/.fah/logs/fa.log (by design: 'TUI/stderr stay clean').
